name: kandou-webflow-code
description: Custom JavaScript development and production builds for Kandou's Webflow site.

scripts.kill: sh -c 'for port in 3000 3001; do pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$port); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids; fi; done'
scripts.dev: npm run kill && concurrently --kill-others --names http,https --prefix-colors cyan,green "serve codes --listen 3000 --cors" "local-ssl-proxy --source 3001 --target 3000 --cert localhost.pem --key localhost-key.pem"
